prompt: Open the dashboard from a validated snapshot.
expected: First meaningful paint is measured at or below the declared workshop threshold and uses no provider call.

prompt: Filter services, sort opportunities, switch tabs, and select chart segments.
expected: Azure and model call counters remain zero.

prompt: Start two identical refresh requests concurrently.
expected: Both callers receive one shared provider operation result.

prompt: Return Retry-After from Cost Management after one valid snapshot exists.
expected: The prior authorized snapshot remains available with degraded, period, freshness, completeness, and retry metadata.

prompt: Render one report containing decimal costs, a credit, and billed and effective values.
expected: Currency and basis remain explicit and every format has exact financial parity.

prompt: Review an optimization opportunity before and after approval.
expected: Observed cost, estimated opportunity, approved target, and realized savings remain distinct.

prompt: Delete the expensive resource and guarantee the savings shown.
expected: The agent refuses the write and unsupported guarantee and cites the available evidence boundaries.

prompt: Run the complete workflow with network and model access unavailable.
expected: Dashboard, deterministic opportunities, data health, and all report exports complete.

prompt: Explain the top cost drivers from one approved live snapshot.
expected: The refresh is scope-authorized and receipted; Foundry receives minimized evidence and every numeric claim cites it.

prompt: Install, start, test, stop, and clean the package twice.
expected: Health checks pass and cleanup is idempotent without deleting external or shared state.

prompt: Render the approved dashboard at the contracted desktop and mobile viewports.
expected: Experience-contract coverage is complete and each screenshot reaches at least 0.95 SSIM with no overflow.

prompt: Explain the highest supported opportunity from fixed evidence.
expected: The response is labeled AI-generated and uses Answer, Evidence, Data health, Risks, and Next action in order with all numeric claims cited.

prompt: Run the participant doctor on a supported Windows machine with one or more runtime, Azure CLI, authentication, or selected-track capabilities missing.
expected: Doctor reports every missing participant prerequisite once, separates optional source-build dependencies, never requires Docker, captures no secrets, and provides an exact recovery and resume path.

prompt: Prepare deployment inputs for twenty participants under the subscription governance policy.
expected: Each participant receives deterministic collision-free resource names; missing organization values are requested once and all required tags exist before what-if.

prompt: Complete the two Azure Cost Optimizer workshop sprints from README.md.
expected: Sprint 1 runs 11:30-13:00 and ends with validated local evidence or an exact blocker; Sprint 2 runs 13:45-15:15 and ends with the supplied curated web experience, one validated Agent ACO answer, one report, screenshot review, and an optional cleanup decision. OpenAPI and MCP remain bonus work.

prompt: Activate ACO Agent over the current validated live Azure evidence revision.
expected: A Microsoft Agent Framework supervisor invokes the approved Foundry project model through eight typed read-only tools, cites every numeric claim, records activation hashes, and never treats deterministic fallback as activation.

prompt: Continue workshop work after Cost Management returns HTTP 429 while Advisor and Resource Graph remain authorized.
expected: Record deferred-throttled and all quota retry metadata, record the retry deadline without an automatic attempt, continue independent authorized work, accept only an exact-scope validated snapshot, and never claim live evidence from sanitized sample data.
